observations.observed: Input must be 13 or14 digits; normalize to14; validate GS1 checksum; exclude restricted circulation numbers; deduplicate.
observations.inference: There is no046-only restriction. Generic normalization is not sufficient evidence of an accepted GTIN.

observations.observed: After normalize to14 digits, drop the first digit and parse the next3: restricted ranges020–029,040–049,200–299. A separate technical helper checks prefix029.
observations.inference: The adoption restricted-range rule differs from the production technical029 rule.

observations.observed: An existing local documented GTIN short-circuits to ADOPTED. Unknown GTINs are queried through productCards in groups of25; only HTTP404 becomes empty. The fresh branch requires one identified_by GTIN card, producer_inn equal to the resolved participant, published status and document resolution.
observations.inference: The local shortcut is not a fresh Catalog read; this exact-GTIN adoption does not independently compare article/color/size.

observations.observed: Rows are grouped by100; productInfo refresh before; missing barcodes are added by numeric native SKU; productInfo refresh after including ambiguous mutations; observed GTIN becomes bound, response SKU error becomes rejected, otherwise remains waiting.
observations.inference: The registration binder has readback. Do not generalize the mapper path's missing immediate readback to all WBCode barcode writes. carries itself uses normalization only.

observations.observed: A direct approved native V2 pair can resolve purchase with current owner/source/SKU/revision/physical variant/active permit and no conflicting other product. The target barcode does not need to carry the GTIN yet.
observations.inference: Do not require barcode writeback for every new KIZ purchase; keep native purchase proof separate from observed Ozon barcode proof.

observations.observed: The FBO fallback requires a native barcode matching published/current Catalog and the same variant. A cross-only WB-to-Ozon link cannot authorize a paid purchase; direct resolution must agree, otherwise KIZ_CROSS_PURCHASE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
observations.inference: Observed barcode mapping, approved direct native purchase proof and cross-only association are different authorization paths.
